problem:
Given that the discrete random variable $X$ has the cumulative distribution function $F(x)$ shown in the table below, compute $P(X=2).$

| $x$ | $-1$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $F(x)$ | $0.05$ | $0.15$ | $0.35$ | $0.60$ | $0.85$ | $1.00$ |

$P(X=2)=$
{{field-1}}
worked_solution:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $X$ is a function $F(x)$ such that

$$
F(x)=P(X\le x).
$$

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}F(2) & =P(X\le 2) \\  & =P(X\in {-1,0,1,2}) \\  & =P(X=-1)+P(X=0)+P(X=1)+P(X=2) \\  & =P(X\in {-1,0,1})+P(X=2) \\  & =P(X\le 1)+P(X=2) \\  & =F(1)+P(X=2).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X=2) & =F(2)-F(1) \\  & =0.60-0.35 \\  & =0.25.\end{aligned}
$$
